project_name: InFlow Revenue Execution Action Workspace Redesign Blueprint

visual_enhancers.glass_card_class: bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-xl shadow-2xl transition-all duration-200

section_1_top_header.name: Workspace Header & CRM Connection Status
elements: Greeting & Subtitle ('Action Workspace — Revenue Execution Engine')

section_2_kpi_row.name: Revenue Attributable KPI Stat Cards (Inspired by Neue AI)

section_3_analytics_summary.name: Revenue Execution Activity & Attributed Value Chart (Neue AI inspired)
section_3_analytics_summary.description: Visualizes daily pushed revenue impact alongside total action velocity across time.

section_4_record_header.name: Target Account / Record Context Bar (Inspired by Taskey)
fields: Status: In Queue / In Review / Pushed to CRM
Tag / Priority: High Impact / Tier-1 Account / Discount Override
Milestone / Completion Progress: e.g. 4/8 Actions Completed progress bar

left_pane_composer.title: Action Composer
features: Dynamic field inputs tailored per action type
AI Draft assistant trigger button with loading shimmer
Owner write gating badge / lock indicator

right_pane_queue.title: Action Execution Pipeline & Views (Taskey inspired view-switcher)

view_implementations.list_view: Data-rich table view with sortable columns, inline review status, batch actions, and row action triggers.
view_implementations.kanban_view: Status columns (Draft -> Pending Review -> Executed -> Failed) with draggable/sortable card layouts containing deal impact metrics.
view_implementations.timeline_view: Timeline horizontal cards aligned by scheduled execution time with urgency indicators.

key_functionalities.1_crm_destination_selector: Dropdown to toggle HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive destination with live auth status and record sync counts.
key_functionalities.2_action_composer: Support 6 distinct action types (Note, Task, Call, Log Email, New Deal, Create Offer) with specific validation, AI prompt drafting support, and draft saving.
key_functionalities.3_action_queue: Manage draft, pending, pushed, and failed actions. Includes 'Review & Push' CTA, single or bulk selection, retry for failed items, and delete capability.
key_functionalities.4_human_in_the_loop_modal: Confirmation dialog summarizing exact CRM payload changes (fields, deal amount, contact email) before triggering CRM write API.
key_functionalities.5_owner_write_gating: Read-only view banner and disabled forms when the current user is not the record/account owner.
key_functionalities.6_empty_state: Sleek dark glass empty state card prompting 'Connect a CRM' with step-by-step setup CTA when no CRM integration is linked.
key_functionalities.7_view_switcher: Seamless tab switcher toggling between List, Kanban (by status), and Timeline (by scheduled date) views for queued actions.

grids.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

layouts.container_padding: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 sm:space-y-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layouts.header_flex: flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4

motion.framer_motion_usage: Animate view switcher tab transitions using layoutId, fade-in staggered entrance for queue items, and smooth dialog modal open/close scaling.

accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA / WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio text on dark glass backgrounds
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full focus-visible outline rings on all interactive tabs, buttons, and form elements

3d libraries.library: None required for dashboard action workspace; relies on Canvas/Recharts and Framer Motion for high-density responsiveness

media.hero_image_overlay: N/A — uses SVG icons and subtle particle/glass gradient background mesh

image_urls.description: Avatars for Account Executives and assignees in Taskey-style record header

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, modal trigger, card, and metric display MUST include data-testid with kebab-case identifiers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 7 key functionalities and layout sections are seamlessly integrated into the React JavaScript (.js) workspace codebase under /app/frontend/src/pages/Workspace.js and sub-components. Maintain the dark electric blue (#0052ff) glassmorphic aesthetic while incorporating the Taskey header + view-switcher patterns and Neue AI KPI + activity chart elements. Ensure full responsiveness, interactive action composition with AI triggers, human-in-the-loop modal confirmation, read-only gating state, and data-testid tags on all actionable elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Do not use generic light theme or Inter-only headers. Use Outfit font for headings. 2. Maintain dark glass panels with bg-white/[0.04], border border-white/10, and backdrop-blur-xl. 3. Accent color MUST be Electric Blue (#0052ff). 4. Never use unstyled HTML select; use Radix / shadcn Dropdown/Select. 5. Include explicit data-testid attributes on all interactive elements. 6. Support JS (.js) file syntax.
